drivers.variant_notes: Pool Player 1.0, declared in src/wpc/capgames.c as a clone of Breakshot's bsv103: plain INITGAME(pp100, 13, ...) with capInvSw13/capFlip13 equal to Breakshot's gameno-5 values and Breakshot's three 1.1 sound ROMs, so PinMAME routes it exactly as Breakshot. Pinball News's report of the flyer describes three Pool Player versions, two with automatic ball launchers and one with a manual launcher, and no source says which of them this firmware ran. The authorized ROM library holds no copy, so nothing here was observed on it. No solenoid 51.
